category.description: Optional category filter to get fees for a specific category

account_type.description: Optional filter — only return accounts of this type. Omit to return all accounts.

limit.description: Maximum number of transactions to return per page (default: all)

offset.description: Number of transactions to skip (for pagination). Use nextOffset from prior response.

account_id.description: Optional account ID (UUID) from get_my_accounts. Omit to return every account's sensitive details.

transaction_id.description: The transaction ID to look up (from get_my_transactions or search_transactions response)

filter.description: Optional: filter by tool name or description fragment (e.g. "user")

query.description: Name, email, or username fragment to search for

account_id.description: Account ID to request the fee waiver for

userId.description: The user ID to mark for password reset

from_date.description: Earliest date (ISO 8601, e.g. "2025-01-01"). Matches on createdAt string prefix.

to_date.description: Latest date (ISO 8601, e.g. "2025-12-31"). Matches on createdAt string prefix.

query.description: The question or decision to reason through (e.g. "Should I transfer $500 from savings to checking?")

context.description: Optional additional context (e.g. account balances, user situation)
